capabilities: Delay opening today's daily note after startup by a configurable 0-120 seconds
Resolve the daily-note command by ID with a fallback prefix search
Optionally skip opening if today's note is already open
Run a secondary rollover command after the daily note opens
Trigger the delayed open manually via command and settings button
disambiguation: Not a todo or rollover plugin itself; it only delays opening the daily note so another plugin's rollover can trigger.
extras: Manual installation only (copy files into .obsidian/plugins); the manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. README documents known limitations where file-creation-triggered rollover may still need the secondary command or manual run.
intentEvidence: An unofficial companion for Rollover Daily Todos.
motivation: The README explains it exists because early note creation during startup on Android and synced vaults caused rollover plugins to miss the file-creation event.
problem: On some setups (especially Android with synced vaults), the daily note is created so early during startup that plugins listening for file-creation events miss it and rollover never runs.

relations.evidence: An unofficial companion for Rollover Daily Todos.

summary: Companion plugin that delays opening today's daily note at startup so the Rollover Daily Todos plugin reliably catches the note-creation event.
